newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: RESEARCH ALERT - Central says Efacec buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Central says Efacec buy.

text.p: Lisbon broker Central Investimentos has recommended shares in Portuguese electrical engineering firm Efacec-Empresa Fabril de Maquinas Electricas as a buy and set a target price of 1,905 escudos.
"Evaluating the share via its Discount Cash Flow and its competitors at home and abroad, we reach a target price of 1,905 escudos, 42 percent above the current price (1,340 escudos)," Central said.
"We are recommending the strong purchase of Efacec (shares), due to a substantial improvement in its profits in 1997," it said.
Central forecasts that Efacec will post a 1997 net profit of 1.03 billion escudos, 1.269 billion in 1998 and 1.567 billion in 1999. Efacec posted a profit of 0.109 billion escudos in 1996.
